name: North American T-28 Trojan
variants: T-28B / T-28C (USN, 1,425 hp, three-blade prop; C has tailhook)
summary: Postwar radial-engined military trainer with tricycle gear; a popular and powerful warbird in the US civil fleet.

wings: Low, straight-tapered wing with squared tips
engines: Big radial engine in a deep cowl
fuselage: Tricycle landing gear with a long nose leg

tellTales: Radial-engined trainer sitting on tricycle gear
Tall, upright stance with a long nose leg

confusedWith.howToTell: The WWII Texan is a taildragger with a smaller cowl; the T-28 has tricycle gear and a bigger radial.
The Texan II is a turboprop with a pointed nose and frameless canopy; the T-28 has a round radial nose.
The CJ-6 is far smaller with a slimmer cowl and a two-blade prop; the T-28 is a heavy airframe with a large deep cowl.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
